versions.description_html:
Master subnetting and CIDR notation easily. Learn how IP addresses, subnet masks, and network blocks work in your home router and Azure cloud.

Your home Wi-Fi router has been subnetting this whole time, and nobody told you. Every device on your network sits inside a block of 256 addresses, and that block is what people mean when they say subnet.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Your Home Router Is Already Doing Subnetting
  • What an IP Address Is Made Of
  • The Slash Number Is Just a Size
  • Why We Split a Network at All
  • The Math Without Fear
  • Where the Classes Went and Why CIDR Won
  • Subnetting in Real Life: Your Office, Your Home, Your VPN
  • Subnetting in Azure
  • What This Means for Microsoft 365
  • What to Remember, and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
